column1: # Gate 0 re-audit. Same rule as cell_adjudication.tsv: every 11th entry by
# (cell, name) from the loaded 661-entry corpus, adjudicated against its cell's
# own anchor definition. Deterministic, no cherry-picking.
# RATER CAVEAT, STATED UP FRONT: the rater (Claude) also produced this filing,
# so this is a SELF-GRADE and is not independent evidence the way Stage 7's
# audit of someone else's filing was. It is published so it can be checked, and
# it is reported alongside two measurements that do NOT depend on this rater:
# the geometric fit proxy (31.8% -> 16.2% in the worse half of 70 cells) and
# the 89.2% agreement with grid_fill, the one source whose original filing was
# YES = clearly belongs. NO = clearly does not. MARGINAL = defensible loosely.
